event_id_policy: Permanent archive IDs are independent of season/card numbers.
source: Split from legacy archive/crypto-history/events.json without renumbering or dropping records.

research.summary: Wei Dai published b-money in November 1998, describing protocols for money and contracts among untraceable entities.
research.significance: Satoshi cited b-money in the Bitcoin white paper; it is a direct conceptual predecessor.

research.summary: DigiCash entered bankruptcy in 1998 after failing to achieve broad commercial adoption.
research.significance: Its failure is important contrast: cryptographic cash existed, but depended on a company and banking partners.
